title: Herbal Crumbly Thai Chicken Braise
description: A soothing and savory Thai-inspired dish perfect for when you're not feeling well, featuring crunchy cashew nuts and a comforting braise.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven or heavy pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the lemongrass, galangal, and red onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cashew nuts, curry paste, fish sauce, and brown sugar; cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the coconut milk; bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low; cover the pot and cook, undisturbed, for 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the cilantro; season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the braise over steamed rice or noodles, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Note: If making ahead, refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months; reheat gently over low heat.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
